question: Compare collection-slip retention at Veylan Seed Conservatory and signed-loan-record retention at Ostren Instrument Library, including both review or dispute exceptions.
answer:
[1] Collection slips are retained for 16 months. If a seed-health review is unresolved, keep the affected slips until clearance is recorded.

[2] Signed loan records are retained for 8 years. If an ownership dispute is open, keep the affected records until the dispute is settled.
